integrity: The proof is independent of the source's ordinary-weight computation: it uses the simplex column geometry and two explicit linear functionals. Two complete finite subspace enumerations reproduce the source's ordinary spectra and verify every higher-support layer claimed for those examples.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to the two repeated appended column types in Theorem 6.6. It does not cover arbitrary simplex extensions or the source's later bent-function construction.
title: Complete higher-support spectrum of the two-block simplex extension
